packages.name: ConvoHop
packages.summary: Client SDK for apps on end-user devices: one signed-in user's conversations, realtime events with replay, the local store, the offline outbox, read receipts, typing, recent activity, call control and push routing. It re-exports `ConvoHopPush`.
packages.runtime: iOS 15 or later, or macOS 12 or later, with Swift 6.1 or later (Xcode 16.4 or later).

packages.name: ConvoHopLiveKit
packages.summary: Call media through the official LiveKit Swift SDK, and CallKit audio session handling on iOS.
packages.runtime: iOS 15 or later, or macOS 12 or later, with LiveKit's `client-sdk-swift` 2.17.0 or later.

packages.name: ConvoHopPush
packages.summary: Push payload parsing, deduplication, the ring ledger and the push recipient, with Foundation only so app extensions can use it.
packages.runtime: iOS 15 or later, or macOS 12 or later, in an app or an app extension.

packages.name: ConvoHopCalls
packages.summary: Incoming calls from PushKit VoIP pushes to CallKit, and outgoing calls through CallKit.
packages.runtime: iOS 15 or later. On macOS it has only the call model.

packages.name: ConvoHopNotificationService
packages.summary: A Notification Service Extension helper that fetches message text on the device when a push has none, and hides the text of other users' pushes.
packages.runtime: iOS 15 or later, or macOS 12 or later, in a Notification Service Extension.
